description: This is the main activity class for an Android weather application, responsible for managing UI updates, user interactions, location services, network requests, and app update checks.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the weather app, handling UI, location, network requests, and app updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, checks for updates, and fetches weather data.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from voice recognition input.

methods.name: setNavigationBarColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the navigation bar.

methods.name: setUpDaysRecyclerView
methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView for displaying weather forecast days.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Sets up UI event listeners for user interactions.

methods.name: searchCity
methods.description: Initiates search for weather data based on city name.

methods.name: getDataUsingNetwork
methods.description: Fetches current location and weather data.

methods.name: setLatitudeLongitudeUsingCity
methods.description: Sets latitude and longitude based on city name via network request.

methods.name: getTodayWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches current weather information from API.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the UI with fetched weather data.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates day names to localized versions.

methods.name: hideMainLayout
methods.description: Hides the main layout and shows the progress indicator.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks internet connection when activity resumes.

methods.name: checkUpdate
methods.description: Checks for app updates and initiates update flow if available.
